subject.title: [Bug]: Fallback model does not report progress correctly during long tasks

question: Should OpenClaw guarantee channel-visible intermediate progress parity for long-running fallback attempts across providers, or document/provider-scope degraded progress as acceptable?
rationale: The current source has fallback and progress plumbing, but docs/tests do not define the cross-provider intermediate progress guarantee needed to choose a safe repair boundary.

options.title: Guarantee parity
options.body: Treat fallback attempts as required to emit the same channel-visible intermediate progress as primary attempts and repair the shared agent/channel routing path with live proof.

options.title: Document degraded progress
options.body: Allow provider-specific fallback attempts to complete silently or with reduced intermediate progress and document that limitation in model failover guidance.

options.title: Scope to affected providers
options.body: Require a live repro for the reported provider pair first, then decide whether the fix belongs in provider capability metadata instead of the shared runner.

recommendation.title: Guarantee parity
recommendation.body: Treat fallback attempts as required to emit the same channel-visible intermediate progress as primary attempts and repair the shared agent/channel routing path with live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The fallback implementation history is the strongest signal for the maintainer decision owner among the inspected files.
